Name: Bachelor Rarecrows
Author: WithoutGravitas
Description:
[size=4]This is a content pack for Content Patcher that will replace the rarecrows with Stardew Valley's eligible bachelors, as well as Gunther and Linus. 

This mod only overwrites the individual tiles for the rarecrows, and so should not conflict with other Content Patcher mods that use the Craftables.xnb file.
[/size][size=5]
Installation Instructions[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]
This was a lot of fun to make and I hope you enjoy it![/size]
